```yaml
name: Agent Board Integration

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '*/5 * * * *'  # run every 5 minutes
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  agent-worker:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    env:
      GITHUB_PROJECTS_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_PROJECTS_TOKEN }}
      GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Rust
        uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: stable
          override: true

      - name: Cache Cargo registry
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cargo/registry
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-registry-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-registry-

      - name: Cache Cargo build
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: target
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-build-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-build-

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: cargo fetch

      - name: Run agent worker
        run: cargo run --bin agent-worker
        env:
          GITHUB_PROJECTS_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_PROJECTS_TOKEN }}
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Notify Slack
        uses: act10ns/slack@44541246747a30eb3102d87f7a4cc5471b0ffb7d
        with:
          webhook-url: ${{ secrets.SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL }}
          status: ${{ job.status }}
          steps: ${{ toJson(steps) }}
          channel: '#ci'
          message: 'Agent worker finished with status ${{ job.status }}'
```
